scope.summary: Implement live effects attachable at whole-object / group-or-layer-ring / single-fill-or-stroke-row scopes carried in the shared StudioEffectStack primitive (non-destructive until expand-appearance), plus named reusable graphic styles in StudioStyleRegistry supporting apply, additive-merge, break-link, redefine-from-selection (updates all linked users), shared style libraries, new-art-inherits-appearance toggle, and clear/reduce-to-basic-appearance; effect stacks are publishable as named effect styles.
acceptance_criteria: effects at 3 scopes via StudioEffectStack + named graphic styles with redefine/break-link; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: effects + graphic-styles panels reachable via author_id
test: effect at object/group/row scope via StudioEffectStack; redefine-from-selection updates all linked users; break-link local copy

risk_if_missed: No live effects/graphic styles; reusable appearance presets missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
